desc:
During a psychiatrist's session with a prisoner, a coordinated uprising suddenly breaks out, plunging the entire prison into chaos.

More updates are coming soon. Please like the game and join the community server to support us.

PC CONTROLS:
Left-Click to Interact
Right-Click to use flashlight
Left-Shift or C to Crouch


WARNING: This game contains high impact blood and distressing content.
FLASHING LIGHTS WARNING: This game contains very intense flashing lights.

A high graphics level is not required, but very much recommended.
Some character types may not interact as intended with the environment.


Tags: Horror, Prison, Adventure, Puzzle, Escape Room, Scary
